title: MCP SDK pinned with ^ semver — breaking minor releases allowed
detail: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.0.0 in mcp/package.json allows any 1.x release. The MCP SDK has had breaking changes between minor versions. A future npm install could silently upgrade to an incompatible version.
fix_hint: Pin to the exact tested version, e.g. "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "1.0.4". Re-test on each intentional upgrade.

title: MCP non-JSON format responses return {_text} — undocumented shape for AI clients
detail: When format=mla/apa/bibtex/ris is requested, client.js returns {_text: string} rather than a JSON object. The MCP tool description does not document this distinction. AI clients that always expect a JSON object will receive a misshapen response without a clear error.
fix_hint: Add a note to the tool description: 'When format is not json, the response is a plain text bibliography in the _text field rather than a structured object.' Or detect at call site in server.js and surface as a separate content block.

title: ApiUsage.key_id has no FK to api_keys — orphaned usage rows accumulate silently
detail: The ApiUsage model references key_id but declares no @@relation to ApiKey. If an ApiKey row is deleted (via user delete Cascade), its ApiUsage rows remain. Over time this pollutes the analytics table with orphaned counts.
fix_hint: Add a relation: keyId ApiKey @relation(fields: [key_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade). Add a migration.

title: relevance_labels table missing from billing migration — re-provisioning will fail
detail: prisma/schema.prisma defines the relevance_labels model but the only migration file (20260530120000_billing/migration.sql) does not create it. A fresh prisma migrate deploy will not create the table, breaking the F2 gold-set harness on a new environment.
fix_hint: Add a second migration file (e.g. 20260531000000_relevance_labels/migration.sql) with the CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for relevance_labels, or append to the existing migration (only safe on a fresh DB).

title: Legacy useSettings.js localStorage keys use bare names — no opencite: namespace prefix
detail: Keys europeanaKey, openAlexKey, openAlexEmail, crossrefEmail, s2Key, enabledSources, curatedJournals, viewMode are written/read without the opencite: prefix. The storage.js wrapper (used by newer code) does namespace. Bare keys risk collisions if the app is ever served on a shared origin, and mixing conventions makes future key migration harder.
fix_hint: Migrate to storage.js for all keys. Run a one-time migration in useSettings.js: read bare key, write namespaced key, remove bare key.

title: users.total_credits is Decimal(12,4) but may be treated as float in JS arithmetic
detail: Prisma returns Decimal values as Decimal.js objects (or strings, depending on the client version). If caller code does arithmetic with + or * rather than Decimal methods, silent precision loss occurs. Credit debit/credit paths in api/_shared/billing.js must coerce carefully.
fix_hint: Audit billing.js for any plain JS arithmetic on total_credits. Prefer Prisma's atomic $increment/$decrement operations which keep the value in Postgres arithmetic.

title: public/output.css is committed — stale during local dev without tailwindcss --watch
detail: The Tailwind output is committed to the repo and served statically. During vite dev, changes to src/input.css or src/**/*.{jsx,js} are not reflected until tailwindcss CLI is also run. A developer running only `vite` will see stale styles.
fix_hint: Add a dev script: "dev": "concurrently \"vite\" \"tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./public/output.css --watch\"". Or import input.css via Vite instead of linking output.css in index.html.

title: @auth/core and @auth/prisma-adapter use ^ semver — Auth.js v5 minor releases have broken adapters
detail: @auth/core ^0.37.4 and @auth/prisma-adapter ^2.7.4 in package.json. Auth.js v5 has historically changed adapter interfaces and session shape in minor releases. An npm install on a new Vercel deployment could silently upgrade to a breaking version.
fix_hint: Pin to exact versions. Use a lockfile (package-lock.json or yarn.lock) and commit it. Enable Dependabot for controlled upgrade PRs.

title: .env.example documents DATABASE_URL/DIRECT_URL but Prisma schema reads POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL/POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING
detail: .env.example shows DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL (old Supabase naming convention). prisma/schema.prisma and scripts/migrate.mjs read POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL and POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING (Vercel Postgres naming). A developer copying .env.example verbatim will get a Prisma environment variable error.
fix_hint: Update .env.example to use POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL and POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING with appropriate comments. Add OPENCITE_MAILTO, KV_REST_API_URL, KV_REST_API_TOKEN, SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY, API_KEY_PEPPER to .env.example as they are all undocumented required vars.

title: API_KEY_PEPPER defaults to empty string — no startup guard for missing pepper
detail: api/_shared/crypto.js:69 uses process.env.API_KEY_PEPPER || "". If the env var is not set in production, all API key hashes are computed without a pepper, reducing the hash to a bare SHA-256. An attacker who compromises the DB can rainbow-table the key hashes. There is no startup assertion that fails if the pepper is missing. [RESOLVED v0.39 — verified in code on-branch 2026-06-08; see sprint_log_v0_39.md.]
fix_hint: Add a startup guard: if (!process.env.API_KEY_PEPPER && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') throw new Error('API_KEY_PEPPER must be set in production'). Or at minimum, warn loudly on startup.
